**Finding: missing (deviation by omission) — TRANSITION**

The Agreement has no post-termination transition or data-return provision:

- **Section 17 (Term and Termination)** runs one-way against us: 17(b) requires *Sparkling* to cease use and certify destruction/return of all Software, Documentation and Codes; 17(c)/the tail at p0129 deals only with insolvency/default and fee refunds.
- **Section 4(b)** has Garman converting our data into its proprietary format, but nothing requires it back.
- **Section 14** covers confidentiality only (no return/destruction mechanic), and **Section 18** survival lists no exit obligation.
- Text searches for "transition" returned nothing, and "data" hits are limited to conversion, confidentiality and liability.

**Redline (validated, ok:true):** new **Section 17(d)** inserted after p0129 — (1) up to six (6) months of transition assistance at Garman's then-current rates on request; (2) return of all our data, including data converted under Section 4(b), in a commonly used machine-readable format within thirty (30) days; (3) deletion thereafter with written certification. Fallback of 90 days' assistance flagged in the comment.
